warnings: Hip roof (ปั้นหยา) on a steel frame over RC ring beams: R1 on rows A and B (split at the column on line 2), R2 on lines 1 and 3 (section R1-R2 on S-03). Two trusses T1 stand at the hip apexes on lines 1''''' (1.50) and 2' (3.50) — the plan labels them 'T1' and brackets the span between them 'โครงถัก ดูแบบวิศวกรรม'. The ridge (อกไก่) runs between the apexes on A'''''' (1.50); four double hip rafters run from the eave corners (1' / 3''' x A' / B'') to the apexes.
The index (A-00) calls this sheet 'แปลนโครงสร้างหลังคา'; the drawing title is 'แปลนโครงหลังคา'. It carries structural marks (R1, R2, T1) so it is roof_frame_plan, not roof_plan.
Section designation printed 'LG -100x50x2.3 mm' with the word เหล็กกล่อง — kept as LG (section 6a: do not translate), d 100 / b 50 / t 2.3.

Hip spans are not printed; 3.82 m is the plan diagonal of 2.70 on both axes (1.20 eave + 1.50 to the apex), span_source local_dimension at a lower score. The ridge 2.00 m is the grid difference 1''''' to 2'.

Rafters (จันทันเหล็กกล่อง LG-100x50x2.3, no mark) are the dashed lines on every tick of S-02's 1.00 inner chains — x lines 1''' .. 3' in the long roof planes, y lines A''' .. B' in the hip ends. The dashed lines are drawn straight across the whole roof, so the per-plane jack-rafter count is left null.

The plan names 'คร่าวเหล็กฉาก L -40x40x2.3 mm ทุกระยะ 0.80-0.90 ม.(เชื่อมติดกับตะเข้)' while the S-04 truss detail prints 'แปเหล็ก [ -75x45x15x2.3 mm @1.00 m'. They are recorded on their own sheets as printed; the คร่าว is the member welded to the hips, the แป is the purlin of the roof planes (S-04, A-04, A-05 agree on it).
Columns C1 continue to the roof (small squares on R1 at A2 / B2) — recorded once, in the footing-plan file.
